channel.title: QuotaWatch: AI coding plan changes
channel.description: Dated, sourced changes to AI coding plan prices and limits.

item.title: Antigravity: Antigravity adds Gemini 4 Argon for paid Google AI Pro, with a separate weekly-only Argon quota
item.description: Antigravity limit change on 2026-10-15: Paid (non-trial) Google AI Pro also gets Gemini 4 Argon with its own weekly-only quota on top of the 3.8 Flash bucket; free Pro trials are excluded; Gemini 3.1 Pro, 3.6 Flash and 3.7 Flash retired outside Enterprise. Source: @antigravity on X (official).

item.title: Cursor: Cursor folds into The X Subscription: Plus $8, Premium $30, Super $100, Ultra $200; legacy Pro $20 / Pro+ $60 closed to new customers
item.description: Cursor plan change on 2026-10-12: Plus $8, Premium $30, Super $100, Ultra $200; Teams $30/$100/$200 per seat; existing subs keep legacy plans. Source: @cursor_ai on X (official).

item.title: X Subscription: The X Subscription launches: one plan across Grok, Cursor and X Premium (Free, Plus $8, Premium $30, Super $100, Ultra $200)
item.description: X Subscription plan change on 2026-10-12: Free $0, Plus $8, Premium $30 (4x), Super $100 (15x), Ultra $200 (50x) per month; yearly $80/$300/$1000/$2000; teams on Premium/Super/Ultra per seat; one shared usage pool across Grok, Cursor and Grok Build. Source: @SpaceXSI on X (official).

item.title: Codex: ChatGPT Pro adds $500 tier; Pro 200 reopens with lower allowance for new non-grandfathered subs
item.description: Codex plan change on 2026-09-29: ChatGPT Pro adds $500 tier; Pro 200 reopens with lower allowance for new non-grandfathered subs. Source: help.openai.com (official).

item.title: Claude: Claude Code weekly limits: permanent +25% vs pre-promo baseline, about 17% below the promo level
item.description: Claude limit change on 2026-09-14: Weekly limits +25% vs pre-promotion baseline for Pro, Max, Team and seat-based Enterprise; 5-hour limits unchanged. Source: @ClaudeDevs on X (official).

item.title: Gemini CLI: Gemini CLI replaced by Antigravity CLI for unpaid and Google One users
item.description: Gemini CLI plan change on 2026-06-18: Gemini CLI replaced by Antigravity CLI for unpaid and Google One users. Source: geminicli.com (official).

item.title: Copilot: Copilot moves to usage-based GitHub AI Credits; base prices unchanged
item.description: Copilot metering change on 2026-06-01: GitHub AI Credits (token-based, at API rates); base prices unchanged. Source: github.blog (official).
